name: list_avatar_looks
description: Returns a paginated list of avatar looks (outfits, poses, styles). Filterable by group_id, avatar_type, and ownership. The look id is the avatar_id to pass when creating a video.

groupId.description: Filter looks to a specific avatar group. Returns only looks belonging to this group.
groupId.title: Groupid

ownership.description: Filter by ownership: 'public' for preset avatars, or 'private' for your own. Omit for all.
ownership.title: Ownership

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page (1-50).
limit.title: Limit

token.description: Opaque cursor token for the next page.
token.title: Token
